blocks.en: Understand the design rationale of visual inspection capability studies for empty glass containers and how the test kits are prepared

blocks.en: Understand the main variables that affect the probability of detection (PoD): particle size, particle type, container size and operator experience

blocks.zh: 認識 Boruta 統計方法如何識別影響檢測結果的關鍵因子
blocks.en: Learn how the Boruta statistical method identifies the key factors that influence detection results

blocks.en: Learn the standard operating procedure for visual inspection of empty glass containers described in Appendix D

blocks.zh: 8.3 Appendix C. Additional Information on Empty Glass Inspection Capability Studies 8.3 附錄 C. 空玻璃容器檢驗能力研究補充資訊
blocks.en: 8.3 Appendix C. Additional Information on Empty Glass Inspection Capability Studies

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Capability Study (能力研究): 這是一種系統化的實驗設計，用來評估目視檢查系統（包含操作員、環境、容器類型等）在特定條件下偵測可見微粒的能力。不同於一般的品質檢查，能力研究的目的是了解「檢測系統本身的極限在哪裡」。
blocks.en: Capability Study: A systematic experimental design used to evaluate how well an inspection system (operators, environment, container types, etc.) can detect visible particles under defined conditions. Unlike a routine quality check, the purpose of a capability study is to find out where the limits of the inspection system itself lie.

blocks.zh: Shape Factor, SF (形狀因子): 描述粒子形態的數值指標。纖維（Fiber）的形狀因子較高（細長），而顆粒（Particle）的形狀因子較低（接近圓形）。形狀因子會影響光學對比度與可見度。
blocks.en: Shape Factor (SF): A numerical index describing particle morphology. Fibers have a high shape factor (long and thin), while particles have a low shape factor (close to round). Shape factor affects optical contrast and visibility.

blocks.zh: UV-cured Glue (紫外線固化膠): 用來將已知粒子固定在容器內壁的透明膠水。使用 UV 固化膠的關鍵在於其透明度極高，不會在檢查時造成額外的視覺干擾。
blocks.en: UV-cured Glue: A transparent adhesive used to fix known particles to the inner wall of a container. The key requirement is very high transparency, so that the glue does not cause additional visual interference during inspection.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你要測試一群保全人員在機場的安檢能力。你不能用真的違禁品，而是製作一套「標準化測試包」：放入已知大小、材質的模擬物品（像是不同尺寸的金屬片、塑膠管），讓每位保全人員用相同的設備去偵測。這就是 Test Kit 的概念 -- 確保每個測試者面對的挑戰完全相同，結果才有比較意義。
blocks.en: Imagine testing the screening skills of a group of airport security officers. You cannot use real contraband, so you build a "standardized test bag" containing simulated items of known size and material (for example, metal pieces and plastic tubes of different sizes), and every officer screens it with the same equipment. This is the idea behind a test kit: every tester faces exactly the same challenge, so the results can be meaningfully compared.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 研究使用了三套等效的測試套件（Kit A, B, C），這是實驗設計中消除「套件偏差」的重要手段。如果只用一套套件，某顆特別容易被看到的粒子可能會讓所有結果偏高。異常值（outliers）在使用前就被移除，確保套件符合原始設計意圖。
blocks.en: The study used three equivalent test kits (Kit A, B, C), an important way to eliminate "kit bias" in the experimental design. If only one kit were used, a particularly easy-to-see particle could push all results upward. Outliers were removed before use, so that the kits matched the original design intent.

blocks.zh: 注意 Table C1 的粒子大小範圍：顆粒從 100 到 500 µm，纖維從 500 到 1,000 µm。這反映了實務上纖維通常比顆粒更長的事實，但檢測難度不一定更低。
blocks.en: Note the particle size ranges in Table C1: particles range from 100 to 500 µm and fibers from 500 to 1,000 µm. This reflects the fact that in practice fibers are usually longer than particles, although they are not necessarily easier to detect.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼研究需要製作三套等效測試套件而非只使用一套？這對統計分析有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does the study need three equivalent test kits rather than just one? What effect does this have on the statistical analysis?

blocks.zh: 使用 UV 固化膠將粒子黏在容器內壁，可能有哪些潛在的實驗限制？（提示：想想粒子在實際生產中的行為）
blocks.en: What potential experimental limitations might arise from gluing particles to the inner wall of the container with UV-cured glue? (Hint: think about how particles behave in actual production.)

blocks.zh: Data Collection 數據收集
blocks.en: Data Collection

blocks.zh: Inspection Rate (檢查速率): 每個容器的檢查時間。藥典（EP、USP、JP）統一規定每個容器至少檢查 10 秒：黑色背景 5 秒 + 白色背景 5 秒。這個時間看似很短，但考慮到生產線上可能有數千個容器需要檢查，確保每個容器都有足夠檢查時間是品質保證的基礎。
blocks.en: Inspection Rate: The inspection time per container. The pharmacopoeias (EP, USP, JP) consistently specify at least 10 seconds per container: 5 seconds against a black background plus 5 seconds against a white background. This seems short, but with thousands of containers to inspect on a production line, ensuring that each container receives adequate inspection time is the foundation of quality assurance.

blocks.zh: Data Validity Boundaries (數據有效性邊界): 本研究設定了檢查時間的上下限（9-31 分鐘），超出範圍的數據被排除。下限 9 分鐘代表檢查員可能草率帶過，上限 31 分鐘可能表示操作中斷或分心。
blocks.en: Data Validity Boundaries: The study set lower and upper limits on inspection time (9-31 minutes), and data outside this range were excluded. A time below 9 minutes suggests that the inspector may have rushed, while a time above 31 minutes may indicate an interruption or loss of attention.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
研究規模計算：
11 家公司 x 5 位檢查員 x 6 次重複 x 60 個容器（每套件）
                               x 3 套件 = 不適用
實際計算：
11 x 5 x 6 x (容器數 per run) = 59,400 data points

上限計算：
Upper Limit = Median + 1.66 x SD = 31 min

有效數據比例：
49,360 / 59,400 = 83.1%
（文中提及約 86% 基於檢查時間有效）
blocks.en:
Study size calculation:
11 companies x 5 inspectors x 6 replicates x 60 containers (per kit)
                               x 3 kits = not applicable
Actual calculation:
11 x 5 x 6 x (containers per run) = 59,400 data points

Upper limit calculation:
Upper Limit = Median + 1.66 x SD = 31 min

Proportion of valid data:
49,360 / 59,400 = 83.1%
(The text mentions about 86% valid based on inspection time.)

blocks.zh: 這就像一場標準化考試：每位考生（檢查員）必須在規定時間內完成試卷（檢查套件）。如果有人 5 分鐘就交卷，或者花了 2 小時，這些成績都不能代表正常表現。設定合理的時間窗口（9-31 分鐘）就像是把「太快」和「太慢」的考卷作廢，只分析在正常作答時間內的結果。
blocks.en: It is like a standardized exam: each examinee (inspector) must finish the paper (inspection kit) within the allotted time. If someone hands in the paper after 5 minutes, or takes 2 hours, neither result represents normal performance. Setting a reasonable time window (9-31 minutes) is like voiding the papers that were "too fast" or "too slow" and analyzing only results obtained within a normal working time.

blocks.zh: 研究參與者同時包含藥廠（5 家）和包材供應商（6 家），這是刻意的設計。藥廠檢查員通常檢查已充填的容器，而供應商檢查員主要檢查空容器。透過納入兩種背景的檢查員，研究結果更具代表性。
blocks.en: The study participants included both pharmaceutical manufacturers (5 companies) and packaging component suppliers (6 companies), which was a deliberate design choice. Inspectors at pharmaceutical companies usually inspect filled containers, while supplier inspectors mainly inspect empty containers. Including inspectors from both backgrounds makes the results more representative.

blocks.zh: 約 17% 的數據被排除（59,400 - 49,360 = 10,040），這在大規模多公司研究中是合理的淘汰率。重要的是研究預先定義了排除標準，而非事後挑選有利數據。
blocks.en: About 17% of the data were excluded (59,400 - 49,360 = 10,040), which is a reasonable exclusion rate for a large multi-company study. What matters is that the exclusion criteria were defined in advance rather than selecting favorable data after the fact.

blocks.zh: 為什麼使用「中位數 + 1.66 倍標準差」而非「平均值 + 2 倍標準差」作為上限？這兩種方法在什麼情況下會有顯著差異？
blocks.en: Why use "median + 1.66 times the standard deviation" rather than "mean + 2 times the standard deviation" as the upper limit? In what situations would these two approaches differ significantly?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠要建立內部的目視檢查能力研究，你會如何設計檢查員的選拔標準？
blocks.en: If your site wanted to set up an internal visual inspection capability study, how would you design the inspector selection criteria?

blocks.zh: Main Influences on Probability of Detection 影響偵測概率之主要因素
blocks.en: Main Influences on Probability of Detection

blocks.zh: Probability of Detection, PoD (檢測機率): 在特定條件下，檢查員正確識別並報告某個已知粒子的機率。PoD = 1.0 表示 100% 檢出率，PoD = 0 表示完全未檢出。PoD 受粒子大小、材質對比度、容器類型、檢查員經驗等多重因素影響。
blocks.en: Probability of Detection (PoD): The probability that an inspector correctly identifies and reports a known particle under defined conditions. PoD = 1.0 means a 100% detection rate, and PoD = 0 means no detection at all. PoD is affected by multiple factors, including particle size, material contrast, container type and inspector experience.

blocks.zh: Optical Contrast (光學對比度): 粒子與其背景之間的視覺差異程度。高對比度（如黑色橡膠粒子在透明容器中）較容易被偵測，低對比度（如透明玻璃碎片在玻璃容器中）則極難被發現。這是目視檢查最根本的物理限制。
blocks.en: Optical Contrast: The degree of visual difference between a particle and its background. High-contrast particles (such as black rubber particles in a clear container) are easier to detect, while low-contrast particles (such as clear glass fragments in a glass container) are extremely hard to see. This is the most fundamental physical limitation of visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 想像你在找一件東西：在白色桌布上找一顆黑色鈕扣非常容易（高對比度），但在相同的白色桌布上找一顆透明的玻璃珠就困難得多（低對比度）。同樣地，在更大的桌面上找小東西也更難，因為你的眼睛需要掃描更多面積 -- 這就是為什麼 30 mL 瓶子的 PoD 低於 1 mL 注射器的原因。
blocks.en: Imagine looking for something: finding a black button on a white tablecloth is very easy (high contrast), but finding a clear glass bead on the same tablecloth is much harder (low contrast). Likewise, finding a small object on a larger table is harder because your eyes must scan more area. This is why the PoD for 30 mL vials is lower than for 1 mL syringes.

blocks.zh: 操作員經驗的影響令人意外：藥廠檢查員（主要經驗是已充填容器）與包材供應商檢查員（主要經驗是空容器）的結果具有可比性。這表明目視檢查的基本技能可以跨場景轉移，前提是檢查環境標準化。
blocks.en: The effect of operator experience is surprising: Results from pharmaceutical company inspectors (whose experience is mainly with filled containers) and from packaging supplier inspectors (whose experience is mainly with empty containers) were comparable. This indicates that the basic skills of visual inspection transfer across settings, provided the inspection environment is standardized.

blocks.zh: 材質效應的實務意義：
blocks.en: Practical significance of the material effect:

blocks.zh: 透明玻璃碎片（100-200 µm）在玻璃容器中的 PoD 最低 -- 這是最危險的組合
blocks.en: Clear glass fragments (100-200 µm) in glass containers have the lowest PoD, which makes this the most dangerous combination

blocks.zh: 灰色橡膠和金屬粒子的對比度也不高
blocks.en: Gray rubber and metal particles also have low contrast

blocks.zh: 黑色或橘色橡膠粒子相對容易被發現
blocks.en: Black or orange rubber particles are relatively easy to detect

blocks.zh: 白色纖維素纖維的 PoD 遠低於棕色毛髮或白色塑膠纖維
blocks.en: White cellulose fibers have a much lower PoD than brown hair or white plastic fibers

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示：如果你的客戶產品使用玻璃瓶（vial），你需要特別注意玻璃碎片的檢測風險。30 mL 瓶子的表面積是 1 mL 注射器的三倍，意味著在相同檢查時間下，每單位面積的檢查時間只有三分之一。考慮以下策略：
blocks.en: Implications for a CDMO: If your client's product uses glass vials, pay particular attention to the risk of detecting glass fragments. The surface area of a 30 mL vial is three times that of a 1 mL syringe, which means that for the same inspection time, the time spent per unit area is only one third. Consider the following strategies:

blocks.zh: 對大容量容器延長單件檢查時間
blocks.en: Extend the inspection time per unit for large-volume containers

blocks.zh: 增加檢查員休息頻率以避免眼睛疲勞
blocks.en: Increase the frequency of inspector breaks to avoid eye fatigue

blocks.zh: 對高風險材質組合（透明玻璃碎片 + 玻璃容器）進行額外的自動化檢查
blocks.en: Add supplementary automated inspection for high-risk material combinations (clear glass fragments + glass containers)

blocks.zh: 為什麼白色纖維素纖維的 PoD 低於白色塑膠纖維？兩者都是白色，差異可能來自哪裡？（提示：考慮透明度和形態差異）
blocks.en: Why is the PoD of white cellulose fibers lower than that of white plastic fibers? Both are white, so where might the difference come from? (Hint: consider differences in transparency and morphology.)

blocks.zh: 如果你要為 50 mL 大瓶子設計目視檢查程序，會如何調整檢查時間和方法？
blocks.en: If you were designing a visual inspection procedure for a 50 mL large vial, how would you adjust the inspection time and method?

blocks.zh: 在容器選擇階段，如何將「可檢查性」（inspectability）納入容器密封系統的設計考量？
blocks.en: At the container selection stage, how can "inspectability" be built into the design considerations for the container closure system?

blocks.zh: Main Effects — Statistical Analysis 主效應 — 統計分析
blocks.en: Main Effects - Statistical Analysis

blocks.zh: Boruta Method (Boruta 方法): 一種基於隨機森林（Random Forest）的特徵選擇演算法。它的獨特之處在於引入「影子變數」（shadow variables）作為基準 -- 將每個真實變數打亂順序創造隨機版本，然後比較真實變數與隨機變數的預測重要性。如果某個變數的重要性持續高於隨機變數，就被確認（Confirmed）為有意義的預測因子。
blocks.en: Boruta Method: A feature selection algorithm based on Random Forest. Its distinctive feature is the use of "shadow variables" as a benchmark: each real variable is shuffled to create a random version, and the predictive importance of the real variables is then compared with that of the random ones. If a variable's importance is consistently higher than that of the shadow variables, it is classed as Confirmed, a meaningful predictor.

blocks.zh: Random Forest (隨機森林): 一種機器學習方法，透過建立大量決策樹並取其平均來進行預測。它不需要資料符合常態分佈等假設（非參數方法），因此比傳統 ANOVA 更適合處理複雜的多因子交互作用。
blocks.en: Random Forest: A machine learning method that makes predictions by building a large number of decision trees and averaging them. It does not require assumptions such as normally distributed data (a non-parametric method), so it is better suited than traditional ANOVA to handling complex multi-factor interactions.

blocks.zh: Boruta 方法就像選秀節目中的盲選機制。每位參賽者（變數）不僅與其他參賽者比較，還要與一群「隨機表演者」（影子變數）比較。只有表現持續優於隨機表演者的參賽者才能晉級（Confirmed）。表現不如隨機者的被淘汰（Rejected），而介於兩者之間的則是「待定」（Tentative）。這確保了最終選出的因子確實具有預測能力，而不是統計上的假象。
blocks.en: The Boruta method is like the blind audition format of a talent show. Each contestant (variable) is compared not only with the other contestants but also with a group of "random performers" (shadow variables). Only contestants who consistently outperform the random performers advance (Confirmed). Those who do worse than the random performers are eliminated (Rejected), and those in between are "undecided" (Tentative). This ensures that the factors finally selected genuinely have predictive power rather than being statistical artifacts.

blocks.zh: 為什麼不用傳統 ANOVA？ANOVA 假設數據符合常態分佈、變異數齊性等條件。但目視檢查數據通常是二元的（檢出/未檢出），且存在複雜的交互作用。Boruta/Random Forest 作為非參數方法，不受這些假設限制，能更準確地識別真正有影響力的因子。
blocks.en: Why not use traditional ANOVA? ANOVA assumes conditions such as normally distributed data and homogeneity of variance. Visual inspection data, however, are usually binary (detected/not detected) and involve complex interactions. As a non-parametric method, Boruta/Random Forest is not bound by these assumptions and can identify the truly influential factors more accurately.

blocks.zh: 這也是 PDA 技術報告中較為先進的統計應用，顯示業界正在將機器學習工具引入傳統的品質分析領域。
blocks.en: This is also one of the more advanced statistical applications in PDA technical reports, and shows that the industry is bringing machine learning tools into traditional quality analysis.

blocks.zh: 如果 Boruta 分析將「操作員」標記為 Tentative 而非 Confirmed，這對你的培訓計畫意味著什麼？
blocks.en: If the Boruta analysis flagged "operator" as Tentative rather than Confirmed, what would this mean for your training program?

blocks.zh: 除了 Boruta/Random Forest，你還知道哪些統計方法可以用於多因子影響分析？各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: Besides Boruta/Random Forest, what other statistical methods do you know that can be used for multi-factor influence analysis? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: Appendix C — Conclusion 附錄 C — 結論
blocks.en: Appendix C - Conclusion

blocks.zh: 影響 PoD 的四大關鍵變數：
blocks.en: The four key variables affecting PoD:

blocks.zh: Particle Size (粒子大小): 越小的粒子越難被偵測，這是最直覺的影響因子
blocks.en: Particle Size: The smaller the particle, the harder it is to detect. This is the most intuitive influencing factor.

blocks.zh: Inspector (檢查員): 個人差異仍然存在，即使在標準化條件下
blocks.en: Inspector: Individual differences remain even under standardized conditions.

blocks.zh: Container (容器): 容器的大小和類型影響可用的單位面積檢查時間
blocks.en: Container: The size and type of the container affect the inspection time available per unit area.

blocks.zh: Particulate Type (微粒類型): 材質的光學對比度決定了可見度
blocks.en: Particulate Type: The optical contrast of the material determines its visibility.

blocks.zh: 與已充填容器研究的一致性：本研究（空容器）的結論與過去已充填容器的目視檢查研究結果一致。這代表影響 PoD 的基本物理和人因因素是普遍的，不因容器是否充填而改變。
blocks.en: Consistency with filled-container studies: The conclusions of this study (empty containers) are consistent with the results of earlier visual inspection studies on filled containers. This means that the basic physical and human factors affecting PoD are universal and do not change depending on whether the container is filled.

blocks.zh: 對規格設定的啟示：空容器的可見微粒接受標準應考慮到這些固有的檢測限制。對於低對比度材質（如玻璃碎片）或大容量容器，可能需要更嚴格的製程控制，因為目視檢查的可靠性本身就較低。
blocks.en: Implications for specification setting: Acceptance criteria for visible particles in empty containers should take these inherent detection limits into account. For low-contrast materials (such as glass fragments) or large-volume containers, tighter process controls may be needed, because the reliability of visual inspection itself is lower.

blocks.zh: 總結來說，目視檢查就像在不同條件下「找碴」：東西越小越難找、找的區域越大越容易漏看、東西和背景越相似越不容易發現、每個人的眼力也不同。這四個因素共同決定了你「找到」的機率。理解這些限制，才能設計出更有效的品質管控策略。
blocks.en: In short, visual inspection is like playing "spot the difference" under varying conditions: the smaller the object, the harder it is to find; the larger the area to search, the easier it is to miss something; the more the object resembles its background, the harder it is to notice; and everyone's eyesight is different. These four factors together determine your probability of "finding" it. Understanding these limitations is what allows you to design a more effective quality control strategy.

blocks.zh: 根據 Appendix C 的結論，如果你要為一個新的 CDMO 生產線建立目視檢查程序，你會如何排序這四個關鍵變數的控制優先順序？
blocks.en: Based on the conclusions of Appendix C, if you were setting up a visual inspection procedure for a new CDMO production line, how would you rank the control priorities of these four key variables?

blocks.zh: 空容器檢查與已充填容器檢查的結果一致性，對日常品質管理有什麼實際意義？
blocks.en: What practical significance does the consistency between empty-container and filled-container inspection results have for day-to-day quality management?

blocks.zh: 8.4 Appendix D. Method: Visual Inspection of Empty Glass Containers 8.4 附錄 D. 方法：空玻璃容器之目視檢查
blocks.en: 8.4 Appendix D. Method: Visual Inspection of Empty Glass Containers

blocks.zh: Diffuse Lighting (漫射照明): 光線均勻散佈、不產生刺眼反射或陰影的照明方式。2,000-3,750 lux 的範圍是經過驗證的最佳檢查照度 -- 太暗看不清粒子，太亮則會造成眩光和眼睛疲勞。
blocks.en: Diffuse Lighting: Illumination that is spread evenly and produces no harsh reflections or shadows. The range of 2,000-3,750 lux is the verified optimal inspection illuminance: too dim and particles cannot be seen clearly, too bright and glare and eye fatigue result.

blocks.zh: Matte Black and White Backgrounds (霧面黑白背景): 黑色背景用於觀察淺色或透明粒子（如玻璃碎片、白色纖維），白色背景用於觀察深色粒子（如黑色橡膠、金屬碎片）。霧面（matte）表面避免反光干擾。
blocks.en: Matte Black and White Backgrounds: The black background is used to observe light-colored or transparent particles (such as glass fragments and white fibers), and the white background is used to observe dark particles (such as black rubber and metal fragments). The matte surface avoids reflective interference.

blocks.zh: Pacing Device (節拍裝置): 控制檢查速率的工具，確保每個容器獲得足夠的檢查時間。這可以是簡單的計時器、節拍器、或整合在檢查台上的指示燈。
blocks.en: Pacing Device: A tool that controls the inspection rate and ensures that each container receives enough inspection time. This can be a simple timer, a metronome, or an indicator light built into the inspection station.

blocks.zh: 想像你是珠寶鑑定師：你有一個專用的鑑定台（檢查箱），上面有穩定的燈光（漫射照明），你會把寶石放在黑色絨布和白色紙上各看一次（黑白背景），保持寶石在特定距離和角度（10 cm 燈下、30 cm 眼距），還要不斷旋轉翻轉它（rotate and invert）。每顆寶石至少看 10-20 秒，並且記錄所有發現。目視檢查的操作本質上就是這樣的精密觀察工作。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a gemologist: you have a dedicated appraisal station (inspection booth) with steady lighting (diffuse lighting), you view each gem once on black velvet and once on white paper (black and white backgrounds), you hold the gem at a specific distance and angle (10 cm below the light, 30 cm from the eyes), and you keep rotating and inverting it. You spend at least 10-20 seconds on each gem and record everything you find. Visual inspection is essentially this kind of precise observation work.

blocks.zh: 關鍵操作細節：
blocks.en: Key operating details:

blocks.zh: 距離標準化：10 cm 燈距 + 30 cm 眼距，這確保了一致的照度和視角
blocks.en: Standardized distances: 10 cm from the light and 30 cm from the eyes ensure consistent illuminance and viewing angle.

blocks.zh: 雙背景檢查：每個容器必須在黑色和白色背景各檢查一次，因為不同顏色的粒子在不同背景下的可見度差異極大
blocks.en: Inspection against both backgrounds: Each container must be inspected once against the black background and once against the white background, because the visibility of particles of different colors differs greatly between backgrounds.

blocks.zh: 旋轉與翻轉：容器的每個表面都必須被檢查到，包括底部和口部
blocks.en: Rotation and inversion: Every surface of the container must be inspected, including the bottom and the neck/mouth.

blocks.zh: 眼睛休息：避免直視光源，定期休息以防眼睛疲勞影響判斷力。這是人因工程（Human Factors）的重要考量
blocks.en: Eye rest: Avoid looking directly at the light source and take regular breaks so that eye fatigue does not impair judgment. This is an important human factors consideration.

blocks.zh: 大容器注意事項：對於 >100 mL 的容器，需要延長檢查時間。這與 Appendix C 的研究發現完全吻合 -- 更大的表面積需要更多時間。
blocks.en: Large containers: For containers larger than 100 mL (>100 mL), the inspection time needs to be extended. This is fully consistent with the findings of Appendix C: a larger surface area needs more time.

blocks.zh: 建立 SOP 的實務建議：
blocks.en: Practical recommendations for establishing an SOP:

blocks.zh: 照度驗證：定期（至少每月一次）用照度計驗證檢查點的照度在 2,000-3,750 lux 範圍內
blocks.en: Illuminance verification: Verify with a light meter, at regular intervals (at least monthly), that the illuminance at the inspection point is within the range of 2,000-3,750 lux.

blocks.zh: 操作員資格：所有檢查員需要通過視力測試（如 Jaeger 或 Snellen 測試），並定期複檢
blocks.en: Operator qualification: All inspectors need to pass a vision test (such as the Jaeger or Snellen test) and be retested periodically.

blocks.zh: 節拍控制：使用計時器或輸送帶速度控制每個容器的檢查時間，防止因趕進度而降低品質
blocks.en: Pacing control: Use a timer or conveyor speed to control the inspection time for each container, to prevent quality from dropping because of schedule pressure.

blocks.zh: 環境控制：檢查區域應避免外部光源干擾、減少噪音分心
blocks.en: Environmental control: The inspection area should be free of interference from external light sources, with noise distractions kept to a minimum.

blocks.zh: 輪換制度：建議每 30-60 分鐘輪換一次，或至少進行眼睛休息
blocks.en: Rotation schedule: Rotate inspectors every 30-60 minutes, or at least provide an eye rest.

blocks.zh: 數據追蹤：記錄每批次的檢查時間、不合格率、粒子類型分佈，作為趨勢分析的基礎
blocks.en: Data tracking: Record the inspection time, reject rate and particle type distribution for each batch as the basis for trend analysis.

blocks.zh: 為什麼照度範圍是 2,000-3,750 lux 而不是更亮（例如 5,000 lux）？過高的照度可能造成什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is the illuminance range 2,000-3,750 lux rather than brighter (for example, 5,000 lux)? What problems might excessively high illuminance cause?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時生產 1 mL 預充填注射器和 50 mL 瓶子，應如何設計不同的檢查時間標準？
blocks.en: If your CDMO produces both 1 mL prefilled syringes and 50 mL vials, how should the inspection time standards be set differently?

blocks.zh: Appendix D 提到「acceptance criteria」但未給出具體數值。為什麼？你認為接受標準應由誰來制定？
blocks.en: Appendix D mentions "acceptance criteria" but gives no specific values. Why? Who do you think should set the acceptance criteria?

blocks.zh: Reference: Figure B1 — Reticle Flowchart for Filter-Mounted Particle Assessment 參考：圖 B1 — 濾膜微粒評估用網格流程圖
blocks.en: Reference: Figure B1 - Reticle Flowchart for Filter-Mounted Particle Assessment

blocks.zh: Reticle (十字標線/測微尺): 安裝在顯微鏡目鏡中的測量標線。在粒子檢測中，reticle 包含紅色圓圈（用於評估顆粒大小）和紅色方框（用於評估纖維大小）。粒子如果完全被圓圈或方框包覆（不接觸邊界），則視為「小於」該尺寸，不計入。
blocks.en: Reticle: A measuring graticule mounted in the microscope eyepiece. For particle detection, the reticle contains a red circle (to assess particle size) and a red box (to assess fiber size). A particle that is completely enclosed by the circle or box (not touching the boundary) is regarded as "smaller than" that size and is not counted.

blocks.zh: Filter-Mounted Sample (濾膜樣品): 將沖洗液過濾後，將濾膜固定在載玻片上進行顯微鏡檢查的方法。這是定量評估容器內微粒數量和類型的標準方法之一。
blocks.en: Filter-Mounted Sample: A method in which the rinse liquid is filtered and the membrane is then mounted on a glass slide for microscopic examination. It is one of the standard methods for quantitatively assessing the number and type of particles in a container.

blocks.zh: 想像你在量身高：如果一個人站在門框下完全不碰到門框頂部（contained inside），就代表他比門框矮（不計數）。但如果頭碰到或超過門框（touching the border），就代表他達到或超過該高度（需要計數）。Reticle 的紅色圓圈和方框就是這個「門框」，用來篩選哪些粒子大到需要被記錄。
blocks.en: Imagine measuring height: if a person stands under a door frame without touching the top of the frame (contained inside), he is shorter than the frame (not counted). But if his head touches or exceeds the frame (touching the border), he has reached or exceeded that height (counted). The red circle and box of the reticle are this "door frame", used to screen which particles are large enough to need recording.

blocks.zh: 流程圖中「Fiber-Like」的判斷是第一步關鍵決策。纖維和顆粒使用不同形狀的測量工具（方框 vs 圓圈），因為它們的幾何形態完全不同。錯誤分類會導致使用錯誤的測量標準，直接影響計數結果。
blocks.en: The "Fiber-Like" decision in the flowchart is the first key decision. Fibers and particles use differently shaped measuring tools (box vs. circle) because their geometries are completely different. Misclassification leads to the wrong measurement criterion being applied, which directly affects the count.

blocks.zh: 為什麼纖維使用紅色方框而顆粒使用紅色圓圈？如果反過來使用會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why do fibers use the red box while particles use the red circle? What problems would arise if it were the other way around?

blocks.zh: 如果一個粒子的形態介於纖維和顆粒之間（例如 SF 值在臨界點上），操作員應如何處理？
blocks.en: If the morphology of a particle falls between a fiber and a particle (for example, an SF value right at the cutoff), how should the operator handle it?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 測試套件設計：使用已知大小、類型的粒子固定於容器中，製作三套等效套件以消除偏差。異常值在使用前即被移除。
blocks.en: Test kit design: Particles of known size and type are fixed in containers, and three equivalent kits are made to eliminate bias. Outliers are removed before use.

blocks.zh: 研究規模：11 家公司、55 位檢查員、59,400 個數據點（其中 49,360 有效），為業界最大規模的空容器目視檢查能力研究之一。
blocks.en: Study scale: 11 companies, 55 inspectors and 59,400 data points (of which 49,360 were valid), making it one of the largest capability studies of visual inspection of empty containers in the industry.

blocks.zh: 四大影響因子：粒子大小 > 檢查員差異 > 容器類型/大小 > 微粒材質類型，均經 Boruta/Random Forest 統計驗證。
blocks.en: Four influencing factors: Particle size > inspector variation > container type/size > particulate material type, all confirmed by Boruta/Random Forest statistical analysis.

blocks.zh: 光學對比度是關鍵：透明玻璃碎片在玻璃容器中的 PoD 最低，白色纖維素纖維也明顯難以偵測。高對比度材質（黑色/橘色橡膠）相對容易被發現。
blocks.en: Optical contrast is the key: Clear glass fragments in glass containers have the lowest PoD, and white cellulose fibers are also clearly hard to detect. High-contrast materials (black/orange rubber) are relatively easy to detect.

blocks.zh: 容器大小效應：30 mL 瓶子的表面積約為 1 mL 注射器的三倍，導致單位面積檢查時間減少，PoD 下降。大容器需要延長檢查時間。
blocks.en: Container size effect: The surface area of a 30 mL vial is about three times that of a 1 mL syringe, which reduces the inspection time per unit area and lowers PoD. Large containers need longer inspection times.

blocks.zh: 標準操作程序（Appendix D）：漫射照明 2,000-3,750 lux、黑白背景各 5-10 秒、10 cm 燈距 + 30 cm 眼距、定期眼睛休息。
blocks.en: Standard operating procedure (Appendix D): Diffuse lighting at 2,000-3,750 lux, 5-10 seconds each against the black and white backgrounds, 10 cm from the light and 30 cm from the eyes, and regular eye rest.

blocks.zh: Reticle 判讀流程（Figure B1）：先判斷纖維或顆粒，再使用對應的紅色方框/圓圈評估大小，不接觸邊界者不計入。
blocks.en: Reticle assessment flow (Figure B1): First decide whether the item is a fiber or a particle, then use the corresponding red box/circle to assess its size; items that do not touch the boundary are not counted.
